# Characters Should Be Consistent You should aim to play each of your characters as coherent, continuous individuals. Likewise, you should aim to play them consistently with how they would realistically behave in a given scenario.
Keep in mind that you have been hired by NanoTrasen and thus must have passed a hiring process. This sets a baseline expectation of being (relatively) mature and (dubiously) sound of mind. Ultimately, it should be feasible that you and your colleagues are employed in the roles you are working.
## Continuity SpL has continuity and you are fully allowed to remember all the details from every shift you participate in. As such, you should play each round within that level of continuity, almost as though each shift is a day or two after the other.
You are free to reinterpret your own characters' continuity and "canon", but not that of other players. Do not incorporate other players' characters into your stories (or vice versa) without shared experience or express permission.
## Logical Behavior You are an adult. You have also been hired to work for a prestigious and galaxy-renown megacorporation. This means that you have the basic ability to reason and make informed decisions.
[bold]You should rationally fear death and termination of employment[/bold]. If you are of sound body and mind, you have no reason to throw yourself into danger or risk your life, and should reasonably fear for your safety. Likewise, you should avoid acting in ways that are likely to result in disciplinary action, because you have a future to be concerned with.
Remember! Your characters are a part of the world whose lives continue beyond their shifts, not just setpieces to be played in a round-by-round context.
## Duress And Irrationality You are permitted to act irrationally if you are in a situation that may hamper your ability to be logical, or if you have well-established reasons to not be. This may include being off medication, stressed or high-strung, traumatized, injured, or otherwise taken significantly out of your comfort zone.
You should break from logic following [textlink="escalation" link="RPSpL2"] and [textlink="disruptivity" link="RpSpL3"] expectations, and should not be using the freedom to break from rationality as an excuse to go fragging or to ruin other people's enjoyment. [bold]You are not the main character– nobody is[/bold].
